title: Readwise Daily Review Backlog
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:highlight source_app="readwise" review_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(review_state!="done",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by source_app
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending daily reviews backlog by source app for Readwise processing.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside Readwise processing.
implementation: Mark each `reading:highlight` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `source_app`.
visualization: Table of source app with pending daily reviews counts.
grandmaExplanation: It checks where unfinished daily reviews are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in Readwise processing.
